scenes.say: Ever wondered how apps run anywhere, fast? That’s Docker magic.
scenes.title: HOOK: FAST APPS
scenes.subtitle: Why is Docker so quick?
scenes.prompt: a flat vector illustration of a magician pulling apps from a hat

scenes.say: But what’s the difference between a container and a virtual machine?
scenes.title: PROBLEM: VM VS CONTAINER
scenes.subtitle: VMs vs containers explained
scenes.prompt: a clean diagram comparing a VM and a container side by side

scenes.say: Step one: Containers share the host’s kernel, so they start in seconds and use less memory.
scenes.title: STEP 1: SHARED KERNEL
scenes.subtitle: Containers use less memory
scenes.prompt: a simple diagram showing containers sharing a central kernel

scenes.say: Step two: Each container runs from an image—a layered, read-only template.
scenes.title: STEP 2: IMAGE TEMPLATE
scenes.subtitle: Images are read-only templates
scenes.prompt: a flat illustration of stacked layers labeled 'Image'

scenes.say: Step three: Containers add a thin writable layer on top, so each can have its own data.
scenes.title: STEP 3: WRITABLE LAYER
scenes.subtitle: Containers can write data
scenes.prompt: a diagram showing a writable layer on top of an image stack

scenes.say: Here’s the twist: Delete a container, and its writable layer vanishes. Oops, data gone!
scenes.title: TWIST: DATA VANISHES
scenes.subtitle: Container data can disappear
scenes.prompt: a flat illustration of a folder vanishing as a container is deleted

scenes.say: To keep your data safe, use volumes or bind mounts. They store data outside containers.
scenes.title: FIX: VOLUMES & MOUNTS
scenes.subtitle: Store data outside containers
scenes.prompt: a diagram showing a container with an external volume attached

scenes.say: Want containers to talk to each other? Use networks and publish ports with dash p.
scenes.title: NETWORK: PORTS & DNS
scenes.subtitle: Connect containers easily
scenes.prompt: a flat vector of containers connected by network lines

scenes.say: Docker Compose lets you run multi-container apps with one YAML file and one command.
scenes.title: COMPOSE: ONE COMMAND
scenes.subtitle: Multi-container made easy
scenes.prompt: a clean diagram of a YAML file launching multiple containers

scenes.say: Interview trap: If your container exits fast, check logs and exit codes. Main process must stay running!
scenes.title: TRAP: EXIT FAST
scenes.subtitle: Troubleshoot with logs
scenes.prompt: a flat illustration of a container with a warning sign and log files

scenes.say: Docker is lighter than VMs, but you must manage data, networking, and troubleshooting.
scenes.title: WHY IT MATTERS
scenes.subtitle: Docker needs smart handling
scenes.prompt: a diagram showing Docker containers vs heavy VMs on a scale

scenes.title: PREP PILOT
scenes.subtitle: Ace your next interview
scenes.prompt: a simple vector of a rocket labeled PrepPilot taking off
